status: Candidate 9 RPM build, 12 packaging regressions, 101 upstream tests (one skip), installed checks and six native lifecycle Valgrind controls complete. root_cause: execute_batch released native operation buffers only after await future. Cancellation skips that continuation, leaking every affected batch.
A synchronous grpc_call_start_batch rejection never schedules Core completion, leaving both prepared buffers and the extra callback reference owned.
The global async state retained its completion queue after the final user; its C++ deque allocations survived shutdown.
changes: Transfer batch cleanup to the Core completion callback; retain buffers until Core finishes even if the awaiting Future is cancelled.
Release rejected batches and the extra callback reference on synchronous failure.
Make operation-result decoding exception safe and free every operation even if one conversion fails.
Candidate 9 clears the global queue after shutdown; a new 20-lifetime regression verifies collection.
